meta.label: COLD OPEN
rules: the picture is cut to the stick timeline: its beats are the shots, its lines are the lines, nothing re-timed
a continuation beat that follows its own shot directly merges into it
a line starts on the frame in which its first sound falls (beat start + t; t may be negative, a pre-lap), ends after the frame of its last sound
mouths and words on the same rule; a line appears in every shot it sounds in (carry = runs in from an earlier shot, pre = starts under this one before its own)
marks come from the stick's own sound spots and text, the takes' words, or a base lock's marks scaled to the new length
the framing decides who shows a mouth (face), not the take's lip_sync flag
meta.note: Nothing here was watched or heard. The numbers are measured from the files; whether the picture reads needs a person.

onscreen.text: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 86

shots.frame: WIDE · the lobby master: the wall screen's snowy meadow (near-photoreal in its bezel), the room around it
shots.does: The NopeAI lobby: rack pillars, LED votives, the neon NOPE AI. Over reception, Ep1's sign: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 86. Staff in tiled rows on beanbags face the wall-sized screen; GERG types on a laptop on his knees. At the back, MAS stands at a high counter with a water glass, THE ORB at his shoulder. On the screen, inside its bezel: a woolly mammoth plodding toward camera through a snowy meadow, too smooth for this building.

texts.text: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 86

lines.text: Eyes up here, everyone. This is AROS. Nobody filmed any of this. It's all made from one sentence.

shots.frame: MEDIUM · SELBEEP under the screen, the remote the size of a clapperboard; the mammoth's foot breaking the bezel on "sentence"
shots.does: SELBEEP steps under the screen and turns to the room. On "sentence", the mammoth's foot breaks the bezel.
cues: music (v1): E02-01 THE MAMMOTH · SET-PIECE SWING, low, chip lead only (the Build's chip lead), in under the clip; the full band never plays here
shots.caption: SELBEEP steps under the screen and turns to the room. On "sentence", the mammoth's foot breaks the bezel.

shots.frame: WIDE · the step-out: the mammoth turns pixel as it crosses the bezel; OTS over Gerg's laptop
shots.does: As it crosses the frame it becomes ours: pixel art, its own colour ramp, palette-cycled fur, 8 drawings held 3 frames each. For two frames, as it steps out, it has a fifth leg. It steps onto the carpet, heading screen-left. Over Gerg's laptop: GERG, not looking up.
cues: music (v1): E02-01 THE MAMMOTH · SET-PIECE SWING, low, chip lead only (the Build's chip lead), in under the clip; the full band never plays here

lines.text: A mammoth walking through the snow. We never said anything about a lobby. It understands physics.

shots.frame: MEDIUM · SELBEEP; the lobby chair beside the mammoth sags and melts; at the back, MAS glances at it
shots.does: SELBEEP answers Gerg. The lobby chair beside the mammoth sags, then melts into the carpet like candle wax. At the back of the lobby, Mas glances at the chair.

shots.does: SELBEEP, beside the melted chair: "Directionally." The card freezes on him.

shots.frame: WIDE · the lobby master, two weeks on: DOT on the ladder swapping the number plates
shots.does: Two weeks later. DOT, up a ladder at the sign, orange lanyard, back to camera, swaps the plates: 86 comes down, 100 goes up. The mammoth wanders off screen-left toward the elevators, its footprints in its own colour ramp. THUD, outside, somewhere beyond the doors. The door glass rattles.

lines.text: That's the mammoth. It's been two weeks, and it has mass now. We're working on it.

lines.text: That's not the mammoth. The mammoth's on the fourth floor.

shots.does: GERG, typing, not looking up, corrects Selbeep.
